replacements.to:
[中文]
生成一张虚构艺术家“林川”创作的博物馆研究级绘画习作，画面为月光下的松林与远山，采用传统矿物颜料和旧纸质感。底部清晰标注“虚构艺术研究习作 / 非真迹”。

[English]
Create a museum-study-style painting by the fictional artist “Lin Chuan”: a moonlit pine forest and distant mountains rendered with traditional mineral-pigment and aged-paper textures. Clearly label it “FICTIONAL ART STUDY / NOT AN AUTHENTIC WORK”.
